name: Ovation Hollywood
description: Ovation Hollywood (formerly Hollywood & Highland) is an iconic entertainment and shopping destination located steps from the Walk of Fame and TCL Chinese Theatre. This open-air complex features shopping, dining, and entertainment experiences in the heart of Hollywood's entertainment district. The center offers visitors a true Hollywood experience with views of the Hollywood Sign and convenient access to major Hollywood attractions.
demographics: Located in the heart of Hollywood, serving tourists, entertainment industry professionals, and locals. High foot traffic from Hollywood Walk of Fame visitors and tourists from around the world.
summary: A premier open-air entertainment complex in the heart of Hollywood, offering world-class shopping, dining, and entertainment steps from iconic Hollywood landmarks.
